title: 2026 event from 3rd August
description: Bengaluru will host the 14th Bengaluru India Nano conference from August 3 to 5. The event's theme focuses on nanotechnology and artificial intelligence convergence for commercialization. It will bring together researchers, innovators, startups, academia, and industry leaders. The conference includes tutorials, plenary talks, an exhibition, and startup pitching sessions. Organizers expect over 80 speakers and 1,000 delegates from many countries.
